name: Cheetah
intro: A cheetah is a wild cat with spots. It is the fastest animal on land.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A cheetah is a slim cat with long legs.
Its tan fur is covered in black spots.
Each cheetah has its own spot pattern.
Black lines run from its eyes to its mouth.
Its long tail has black rings at the end.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Most cheetahs live in Africa.
A few cheetahs live in Iran, in Asia.
They like open grasslands and savannas.
Cheetahs are endangered, so people work to protect them.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Cheetahs are carnivores, so they eat meat.
They hunt gazelles, impalas, and hares.
They hunt in the daytime.
They use their sharp eyes to find food.
They sneak close, then run very fast.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: Baby cheetahs are called cubs.
A mom often has 3 to 6 cubs.
Cubs have fluffy gray fur on their necks and backs.
Cubs learn to hunt by playing.
They stay with mom until they are about one and a half years old.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: Cheetahs are the fastest animals on land.
A cheetah can run as fast as a car on the highway.
Cheetahs cannot roar.
They chirp and purr instead.
Their long tails help them turn while running.
